ModMetaData.name: Forbidden Mushroom
ModMetaData.author: ztac
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the Meat Shroom, a fungus that grows meat, and a family of forbidden mushrooms with powerful effects.

MEAT SHROOM
Farm it in any soil or in the dark. Its flesh is a raw meat that every cooking recipe accepts, so you get a meat supply without a single animal. Meals made with it give a small mood boost, animals eat it, and traders stock and buy it.

MYCELIUM SNARE
A one-tile hidden trap built from meat shroom flesh. It roots the victim in mycelium, which downs them for capture and makes them starve much faster.

CAPS (Mycology research tab)
Sixteen sibling mushrooms that give temporary effects when eaten, from combat and healing to labor and the dangerous forbidden caps such as rotcap, whisper cap and gorecap. Each has a downside.

REFINED CAPS AND PACKAGES
Research lets you steep caps in shroom broth to remove their downsides, and bundle each group's caps into a single package that applies every effect at once.

No other mods required. Safe to add to an existing save.
